literal_originals.text: | F1-T03 | 身份与企业隔离 | 园区、企业、用户、运行身份、字段/Case授权；至少两个企业和两个园区配置 | AT-04、AT-19 |
| F2-T06 | 办理模板与新输入 | 审核后参数化服务包模板；新企业冷会话与新材料运行，不复制旧数据/身份 | AT-08、AT-35 |
| AT-04 | 跨企业/园区隔离 | 猜测另一企业ID访问资料、Case、结果和匿名占用记录 | 后端隔离；不能泄露别家资料、身份和预约用途；汇总另授权 | F1 |
| AT-08 | 模板新输入与冷会话 | 应用参数化模板并运行有效新输入及错误输入 | 产生新Case和结果；不复制旧材料/授权；错误明确处理 | F2 |
| AT-35 | 首个完整办理和重新使用 | 规划→确认→本地办理→补件/接单→回执→确认；再次运行 | 关键状态持久化并能被对应角色操作；不靠手改源码/数据库；不同输入输出不混淆 | F2 |
界面面向企业经办人、园区服务专员、资源管理员、服务执行者四类角色；提供桌面网页和基本窄屏适配，不另开发小程序或原生手机应用。服务方仅见被分配步骤的必要信息，运营人员也不默认拥有全部企业原始材料。
首版至少测试两个企业、两个园区配置和多种角色。有效权限为当前用户授权、Case范围、服务发布所需能力、运行身份与当前Grant的交集。企业ID由后端会话/授权确定，不能相信请求体自行指定。
企业事实、资源占用、搜索、导出、缓存与模型上下文都进行后端隔离。资源可用性查询可显示匿名占用，不泄露其他企业名称或用途；服务方只获取办理所需字段。运营汇总也需独立授权，小样本数据不默认公开。

AT-04.steps: 猜测另一企业ID访问资料、Case、结果和匿名占用记录
AT-04.oracle: 后端隔离；不能泄露别家资料、身份和预约用途；汇总另授权
AT-04.reset: 待每个执行器绑定隔离合成fixture；禁止生产重置

AT-08.steps: 应用参数化模板并运行有效新输入及错误输入
AT-08.oracle: 产生新Case和结果；不复制旧材料/授权；错误明确处理
AT-08.reset: 待每个执行器绑定隔离合成fixture；禁止生产重置

AT-35.scenario: 首个完整办理和重新使用
AT-35.steps: 规划→确认→本地办理→补件/接单→回执→确认；再次运行
AT-35.oracle: 关键状态持久化并能被对应角色操作；不靠手改源码/数据库；不同输入输出不混淆
AT-35.reset: 待每个执行器绑定隔离合成fixture；禁止生产重置

rows.given: A fresh owned setup, never an imported or prior one-scope state.
rows.must_change: Exactly two distinct park/org pairs, six different actor identities and six independently generated sessions; each pair has owner/reviewer/executor, its own SYNTHETIC catalog and two resources.
rows.must_preserve: Zero Run/Case/preparation/plan/dispatch/receipt/Run-assignment/business approval initial state. Same role/capability kinds and least app SQL privilege as baseline.
rows.negative: No new production authority, no copied old actor or Case marker, no implicit setup/migration/seed during serve.

rows.given: Select each scope using private explicit enterprise/specialist/executor and second_* session keys.
rows.must_change: The ordinary current-session catalog resolves only the matching scope actors/services/resources; second credentials/IDs differ.
rows.must_preserve: The backend determines park/org from current authorization, never a client role/org choice; token/DSN absent from stdout, URL and public evidence.
rows.negative: A foreign token plus guessed ID does not reveal another scope identity, title, material, goal or purpose.

rows.given: Normal configured API and real ordinary worker started from the same retained fresh cluster.
rows.must_change: Only the second scope configuration/metadata and documented session selection are added.
rows.must_preserve: LOCAL + CURRENT_PREPARATION and original planner/P1-P5 algorithms/explicit REVIEW CONFIRM ADOPT VERIFY; no Store.finish/assign_status/fixture approval during user operations. Native/formal/V4 and old isolated fallback stay rejected.
rows.negative: Presence of the second scope cannot grant whole-Run access to an executor or manufacture approval.

rows.given: The new retained state requires both fixed scope bindings.
rows.must_change: Both bindings are authenticated to the actual owned catalog/authority/resource state by the retained state/source fence.
rows.must_preserve: Missing, swapped, foreign or edited scope metadata is refused before PostgreSQL launch; source/ACL/session drift remains refusal without repair.
rows.negative: Old one-scope state is not accepted, migrated, or silently seeded by the new launcher; unknown state/PID/lock remains untouched.

rows.given: First pair makes one isolation-control Case; the cluster is physically stopped and restarted; second pair first uses a cold session.
rows.must_change: Different new goal and two materials create new Run, Case, preparation, plan, dispatch and receipt/evidence identities, using second actors/catalog/resources.
rows.must_preserve: Actual user-authorized HTTP/original page and worker chain reaches explicitly observed P1-P5 and current downloadable result; no runtime database edits to drive the positive chain.
rows.negative: Cannot count old Case outputs, a copied input/marker, or repeated same-enterprise A/B as the second-enterprise first case.

rows.given: Each pair guesses the other pair known Run/Case/preparation/plan/result/receipt ID.
rows.must_change: Both directions exercise actual backend denial at the selected original read/navigation/download boundaries.
rows.must_preserve: Deny before returning foreign business/identity fields and preserve the owner current result/history.
rows.negative: A filtered list alone is not proof that direct ID, cold GET or download is protected; record tested surfaces precisely.

rows.given: A foreign scope tries creating preparation on the old Run, selecting foreign specialist/executor, or submitting another scope old source proof.
rows.must_change: Actual original write endpoints reject cross-parent IDs and otherwise internally consistent foreign source/revision proof.
rows.must_preserve: No new foreign business record, state transition or altered current adoption; audit denial rows may occur and must be measured separately.
rows.negative: Do not replace 403/409/422 with successful no-op; exact expected code follows each already-frozen endpoint contract.

rows.given: Both scopes use their own distinct two-resource combinations in overlapping time intervals in the same cluster.
rows.must_change: Each sees/holds/links only its own authorized resource IDs; foreign hold/combination/link attempts deny in both directions.
rows.must_preserve: No foreign occupation owner/purpose or resource grants are revealed; original capacity/atomicity rules and existing resource occupancy remain.
rows.negative: Independent resource sets do not demonstrate shared-resource capacity contention or a full Cartesian park/org isolation matrix.

rows.given: Physical same-cluster restart between scope Cases, then cold reads of the first case while using the second.
rows.must_change: Independent second records appear while original first Case/history/TXT remain byte/semantic stable under the original canonical download rule.
rows.must_preserve: First OFFER/deadline/generations/resource expiry and capability intersections persist; serve does not renew/reissue grants or markers.
rows.negative: Restart/second session cannot revive a first-scope expired/revoked action; a cold read is not new verification.

rows.given: Finite fixed-SHA verification after source freeze.
rows.must_change: Record actual phase/nodeids, commands, independent probes, source hash/import origins and PRE/POST shared/mirror hashes.
rows.must_preserve: Keep all failures and actual lifecycle/children proofs; source scripts included in import audit, own secrets excluded from publication with raw/public paired hashes.
rows.negative: No counting prior14/current same-scope A/B reruns; no claim full template release, formal AT35, real browser/Windows/native install/model/external production/business completion.

read_boundary: Only baseline Git blobs/original plans/fixed AT and the committed new contract read. No new implementation WIP read. No DB/process/test/network/permission operation.
write_boundary: Only this new reviewer-owned runtime directory.
